messages:
elaine: Quick sync 1: partner asks to fast-track a NorthCloud marketplace listing. They need: SOC2 report (PDF), pentest executive summary, completed supplier questionnaire, firmware SBOM (if HW), and an artifacts manifest. Deadline: ~14 days. Who can pick up which item?
omar_s: I can collect SOC2 + pentest summary + draft the attestation statement. Important: do NOT include secrets or raw exploit logs in public bundle; raw may be shared under NDA only. Also need confirmation that any KMS/HSM references are non-sensitive.
viv_k: I'll own partner coordination and the supplier questionnaire. Please tell me preferred manifest format and upload window.
alex_p: Manifest: CSV with columns (filename, sha256, size_bytes, artifact_type, contains_secrets, owner_email). Use 'contains_secrets' = yes/no. For uploads we normally give 72h presign; if reviewers request, extend to 7 days.
marcus: I'll do the presign and portal walkthrough. Can run a 20-30 min demo for vendor + SI on Wed 10am PT. Will invite Omar, Alex, Viv, and Elaine.
omar_s: Redaction guidance: provide a 1-page pentest exec summary + vulnerability scorecard (CVSS or internal), and mark raw reports redacted for PII/keys. If pentest > 12 months old require a scoped attestation or new scan. Include a short attestation line: "We confirm no production secrets included in submitted artifacts."
viv_k: Noted. I'll request SBOM from HW PM and CI provenance from SI. If SBOM unavailable, mark NA in manifest.
elaine: Proposed owners: Omar = security artifacts + redaction sign-off, Viv = partner liaison + questionnaire, Alex = manifest schema + validation script, Marcus = presign/upload ops. Agree?
alex_p: Agree. I'll also provide a small validation script snippet to check manifest and file names. Suggested filename pattern: ^([a-z0-9-]+)_(\\d{8})_(soc2|pentest|questionnaire|sbom|arch)_v\d+\.zip$ (we'll share corrected regex in doc).
marketplace-bot: Reminder: portal requires a single "compliance_contact" email and retention for review artifacts defaults to 90 days unless legal requests otherwise. Docs: https://redwood/internal/marketplace/compliance-guidelines
marcus: Invite scheduled Wed 10am PT. If that conflicts ping me. I'll add a calendar with join link and attach portal quickstart.
omar_s: Also FYI 1: include a short SBOM summary for any firmware: third-party libs and license summary. If any cryptography bundles reference keys, flag them.
viv_k: I'll chase SI and HW PM now and report ETA here.
elaine: Who will perform final redaction verification before upload? We need a single signer.
omar_s: Security will sign off on redaction. Partner must submit redacted bundle for portal and retain raw under NDA for legal if requested.
viv_k: :thumbsup: I'll keep a running checklist and update thread as artifacts arrive.
elaine: Great. I'll post the checklist link and owners by EOD. Post blockers here so we can escalate.
marketplace-bot: Note: uploads with 'contains_secrets=yes' will be blocked by the validator. If you need to transfer sensitive items request an NDA workflow to legal.
elaine: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Viv to collect ETA, Omar to prepare attest text, Alex to share validator script, Marcus to run walkthrough.
viv_k: Pinged SI. Expect SOC2 + questionnaire in 4 business days, pentest summary in 5-7 days depending on vendor.
marcus: I'll hold upload window open once Omar confirms redaction sign-off.
elaine: Closing here unless new blockers.
